oman: Oman is a country in Asia, the capital city is Muscat.
omit: If you omit something, you leave it out.
ominous: If something is ominous, it relates to omens; it is significant.
If something is ominous, it gives an indication that something bad is about to happen; it is threatening.
The dark clouds moving into the area that we live in is an ominous sign that a bad storm is about to happen.
omen: An omen is a warning or a sign about a good or bad event that will happen in the future; it is an augury or foreboding.
An omen is something of prophetic importance.
If you omen something, you predict its happening with an omen.
ominously: If something is done ominously, it is done in an ominous manner; it is done with a lot of foreboding.
ominousness: Ominousness is the state of being ominous; it is a state of foreboding.
omnipotence: Omnipotence is the ability to do anything, or to have unlimited power.
omelette: An omelette is a dish of beaten eggs cooked in oil, often with cheese and sometimes with other ingredients.
For breakfast, I had a three-egg ham and cheese omelette.
omar: Omar is a male given name.
omission: An omission is a failure to do or include something.
The story is misleading because of all the lies and omissions.
omnivore: An omnivore is an animal which eats both plants (like a herbivore) and meat (like a carnivore).
Bears are omnivores: they can eat plants, but they also eat fish.
omnibus: If something is an omnibus, it contains multiple items.
omnipresent: If something is omnipresent, it can be found everywhere.
omnipotent: Something that is omnipotent is infinitely strong.
omniscient: Someone who is omniscient knows absolutely everything.
omnishambles: An omnishambles is a situation that has been managed badly in every way.
The project turned into an omnishambles because of poor planning.
